ValidationRule.description: Venkat: Created as part of NZC Implementation Purpose: Created to check whether the valid 2 character country code is entered or not
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( ISBLANK(Country__c), LEN(Country__c) <> 2, NOT(CONTAINS( $Label.NZC_Country_Codes , Country__c)), CONTAINS (Country__c,';') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter a valid 2-character country code.
